subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blanks.**

Fingernails and toenails helped our _________ to climb trees, peel fruits and use simple tools. While their colour and condition offer clues about your ________health. Nail polish turns them into fashion accessories.
solution:
The correct answer is: **ancestors; overall**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence talks about how fingernails and toenails helped our ancestors climb trees, peel fruits, and use simple tools.
 
• The word "**ancestors**" fits in the first blank as it refers to a person, typically one more remote than a grandparent, from whom one is descended. (एक व्यक्ति, जो आम तौर पर अपने दादा-दादी से अधिक दूर का व्यक्ति होता है, जिनके वंशज हैं)
 
 
• **For example- ***I often wonder about the lives and stories of my ancestors.*
 
 
 
• The word "**overall**" fits in the second blank as it means considering or including everything or everyone. (हर चीज़ या सभी पर विचार करना या शामिल करना)
 
 
• **For example- ***Overall, the event was a great success.*
 
 
 
• The sentence also mentions that the colour and condition of nails offer clues about overall health.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**.

**Complete sentence: ***Fingernails and toenails helped our ancestors __to climb trees, peel fruits and use simple tools. While their colour and condition offer clues about your __overall __health. Nail polish turns them into fashion accessories.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• The other options do not fit the context of the sentence. However, let us look at the meaning of those words.
 
 
• **Predecessor **means a person who held a job or office before the current holder. (वह व्यक्ति जिसने वर्तमान धारक से पहले कोई नौकरी या पद संभाला हो)
 
• **Universal **means applicable everywhere or in all cases. (हर जगह या सभी मामलों में लागू)
 
• **Forefather **means a male ancestor, who lived in the past and is considered to be part of one's family lineage or heritage. (एक पुरुष पूर्वज, जो अतीत में रहता था और जिसे किसी के पारिवारिक वंश या विरासत का हिस्सा माना जाता है)
 
• '**All in all**' means considering everything or everyone. (हर चीज़ या हर किसी पर विचार करना)
 
• **General **means common, usual, or ordinary. (सामान्य या साधारण)
 
• **Altogether **means completely or in total. (पूर्णतया या समग्रतः)
